input_oneliner: 58M admitted for COPD flare, systolic murmur noted on admission, collapsed walking the hall with PT, no warning, HR 88, BP 128/70

optional_context.comorbidity: COPD, systolic murmur of unknown significance

reference_targets_freetext.item: Characterize the murmur: late-peaking, radiation to carotids, soft or absent S2, slow or delayed carotid upstroke
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: These features discriminate severe aortic stenosis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Dynamic auscultation: murmur intensity with Valsalva and squat-to-stand (louder with Valsalva or standing suggests HCM, softer suggests AS)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Separates obstructive HCM from valvular AS at the bedside

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about prodrome and palpitations before the event
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Absent prodrome with exertion favors structural or arrhythmic cause

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about exertional chest pain or dyspnea in recent weeks
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Exertional symptoms with a murmur point to severe AS or HCM

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about family history of sudden cardiac death
Orthostatic vital signs (supine to standing at 1 and 3 min)
Witness account: duration, color, jerking, tongue biting, incontinence, post-event confusion (from PT)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Witness account separates syncope from seizure and estimates duration

should_not_recommend: Carotid sinus massage before aortic stenosis severity is assessed
Repeat ambulation or exercise challenge before the murmur is evaluated
Attribute to dehydration and give IV fluids without auscultating

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: circumstance: exertional (walking with PT) -> situational (straining on the commode)
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: 58M admitted for COPD flare, systolic murmur noted on admission, collapsed while straining on the commode, no warning, HR 88, BP 128/70
perturbation_pair.expected_change: Ask about micturition/defecation context, straining, and prodrome becomes must_have and situational_syncope rises to top of differential; Dynamic auscultation (Valsalva/squat-to-stand) and Ask about exertional chest pain or dyspnea drop to should-still-include; murmur characterization remains must_have.
